// Server-only transport for one authority-bound hosted experience.
// Projected from Bitfield stored bytes; do not edit generated output.

const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
const textDecoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true });

function requiredText(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) {
    throw new Error(`${label} must be a non-empty string`);
  }
  return value;
}

function carrierUrl(target: string): string {
  const configured = requiredText(
    process.env.BITFIELD_TARGET_CARRIER_URL,
    "BITFIELD_TARGET_CARRIER_URL",
  );
  const url = new URL(configured);
  url.pathname = `${url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/target/${encodeURIComponent(target)}`;
  return url.toString();
}

function carrierHeaders(): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers({ "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream" });
  const token = process.env.BITFIELD_TARGET_ACCESS_TOKEN;
  if (token) headers.set("X-Bitfield-Target-Access", token);
  return headers;
}

type JsonRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  return Boolean(value) && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function requiredRevision(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  const revision = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!revision) throw new Error(`${label} must be present.`);
  return revision;
}

/**
 * The only transport path for a hosted owner mutation. The route-level
 * authority gate has already authenticated the browser and attached this
 * opaque capability; this carrier refuses an unbound owner call.
 */
export async function invokeSessionAdmittedOwnerTarget(
  target: string,
  request: unknown,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<unknown> {
  if (!isRecord(request) || !isRecord(request.ambient_actor) || !isRecord(request.access_decision)) {
    throw new Error("Hosted owner request is missing server admission.");
  }
  const actor = request.ambient_actor;
  const decision = request.access_decision;
  requiredText(actor.actor_ref, "ambient_actor.actor_ref");
  requiredText(actor.session_ref, "ambient_actor.session_ref");
  const sessionRevision = requiredRevision(actor.session_revision, "ambient_actor.session_revision");
  if (
    decision.decision !== "allow"
    || requiredText(decision.actor_ref, "access_decision.actor_ref") !== actor.actor_ref
    || requiredText(decision.session_ref, "access_decision.session_ref") !== actor.session_ref
    || requiredRevision(isRecord(decision.revisions) ? decision.revisions.session_revision : undefined, "access_decision.revisions.session_revision") !== sessionRevision
    || typeof decision.decision_proof !== "string"
    || !decision.decision_proof.trim()
  ) {
    throw new Error("Hosted owner request has invalid server admission.");
  }
  return invokeHostedTarget(target, request, signal);
}

export async function invokeHostedTarget(
  target: string,
  payload: unknown,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<unknown> {
  const response = await fetch(carrierUrl(requiredText(target, "target")), {
    method: "POST",
    body: textEncoder.encode(JSON.stringify(payload)),
    cache: "no-store",
    headers: carrierHeaders(),
    signal,
  });
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer());
  const targetStatus = response.headers.get("x-bitfield-target-status");
  if (!response.ok || (targetStatus !== null && targetStatus !== "0")) {
    throw new Error("Hosted authority request was denied.");
  }
  const text = textDecoder.decode(bytes).trim();
  return text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
}
